name: Breadcrumbs
description: A breadcrumb navigation component that renders an ordered list of links showing the user's location in a hierarchy. The last item is the current page and is rendered as a non-interactive span with aria-current="page".

notes: Wraps the list in a <nav> element with aria-label="Breadcrumb".
The last item (current page) has aria-current="page" and is rendered as a <span>, not a link.
Separator elements are aria-hidden to avoid noise for screen readers.

items.description: Ordered array of breadcrumb items. The last item is treated as the current page.

separator.description: The separator rendered between breadcrumb items. Defaults to a forward slash.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the nav element.

do: Include the full path from root to the current page.
Keep labels short and matching the page titles they link to.
Omit the href on the last item — it is the current page and must not be a link.
dont: Do not use breadcrumbs for single-level sites — they add noise without value.
Do not make the last item a link — it must be a span with aria-current="page".
Do not provide more than 5-6 items — truncate intermediate levels if the hierarchy is deep.
